description: Create a character style (Zeichenformat) with name and at least one of font_family, font_style (exact InDesign style name), point_size, fill_hex (creates an RGB swatch) or swatch_name (an existing swatch by exact name; not together with fill_hex), and tracking (Laufweite in 1/1000 em, -1000 to 10000; where the style is applied it replaces the tracking of the paragraph style – see apply_character_style_to_range). on_collision: error (default), update or version. Returns style_id, name, collision (none, updated, versioned), existed, applied[] and the definition read back (null for attributes the style leaves untouched); based_on alone is enough for a new style. based_on sets the parent style (Basierend auf), also from a group ("Group/Style" for an ambiguous name); group puts a new style into a style group (Formatgruppe), path "A/B" or ["A", "B"], creating missing groups. The answer adds based_on and group as read back, created_groups[] (paths of groups created by this call) and changes.created_group_ids. InDesign names a family with a format suffix such as "Source Sans 3 (OTF)" or "(TT)" when it knows the family in more than one format; pass the family with or without that suffix – the connector matches both and reads back the name InDesign uses.

based_on.description: Parent style (Basierend auf) by exact name, also from a style group; "Group/Style" picks one of several styles with the same name. "[None]" names the built-in root in every language. An unknown name fails with not_found (details.code "based_on_not_found"); a circular chain with invalid_state ("based_on_cycle"). Attributes passed in the same call stay set on this style; everything else follows the parent.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

fill_hex.description: Text colour as hex; an RGB swatch is created if needed. Not together with swatch_name.

anyOf.description: Group path, levels separated by "/", e.g. "Headings/Main"; "" means the top level.
Group path as a list of group names, top level first – for group names that contain "/"; [] means the top level.

group.description: Style group (Formatgruppe) for a new style; missing groups along the path are created. With group, an existing style counts only in that group (another style of the same name elsewhere is no collision, a warning names it), and update never moves a style between groups. A group and a style of the same name cannot share a level in InDesign: invalid_state with details.code "style_group_name".

name.description: Style name; must not start with "[".

on_collision.description: What to do when the name exists: error (default) fails, update changes the existing one, version creates "Name 2".

swatch_name.description: Text colour as an existing swatch by exact name (CMYK, spot, tint or gradient; see list_swatches). Not together with fill_hex.

name: define_character_style
title: Define a character style
